meta.title: 收房被物业卡物业费？一条法规直接拿捏
meta.title_en: Property Fee Blocking House Acceptance? One Law to Win

scenes.title_en: The property office ties fees to viewing
scenes.context: 业主收房被物业拦下，物业要求先交物业费才带看房。
sentences: 我20年买的房子，你怎么都不让我看一眼？
I bought this place back in 2020 — why won't you even let me look at it?
让我看一眼：let me take a look
你交了物业费，我立马带你去现房，就这么个流程。
Pay the property fee first, and I'll take you to the unit right away — that's the process.
物业费：property fee
正常流程不是产证办完、双方签交接单吗？
Isn't the normal process to sign the handover form once the title is done?
交接单：handover form
paraphrase: 先交接后费用，顺序不能倒
Handover comes first; fees come after.
Tying fees to viewing muddles the process.
scenes.speak: I bought this place back in 2020 — why won't you even let me look at it? Pay the property fee first, and I'll take you to the unit right away — that's the process. Isn't the normal process to sign the handover form once the title is done?

scenes.context: 业主引用物业服务收费管理办法第16条，指出开发商原因未交付时物业费由开发商全额交纳。
sentences: 按照物业服务收费管理办法第16条，因开发建设单位原因未按时交给买受人的物业，物业服务费用由开发建设单位全额交纳。
Under Article 16 of the Property Fee Management Measures, when a developer fails to deliver a unit on time, the developer pays the full property fee.
开发建设单位：the developer
如果我收房过程中有争议需要延迟接收，物业费要按解决问题后的时间算。
If disputes delay my acceptance, the fee should only run from when the issues are resolved.
延迟接收：delayed acceptance
不然我整改期间的物业费不就全白交了吗？
Otherwise I'd be paying for property fees during the fix-up period for nothing.
整改期间：the fix-up period
paraphrase: Redirect the liability to the developer.
scenes.speak: Under Article 16 of the Property Fee Management Measures, when a developer fails to deliver a unit on time, the developer pays the full property fee. If disputes delay my acceptance, the fee should only run from when the issues are resolved. Otherwise I'd be paying for property fees during the fix-up period for nothing.

scenes.title_en: Fighting back with evidence and penalties
scenes.context: 业主表明已录音并要去住建部门，再亮出逾期交房违约金条款，物业当场服软。
sentences: 反正刚才过程我都记录下来了，那我先去住建部门反映一下。
I've recorded everything that just happened, so I'll take this to the housing authority.
住建部门：the housing authority
合同逾期交房违约责任每天是万分之三，我这150万的房子每个月就13500块。
The contract's late-delivery penalty is 0.03% a day — on my 1.5 million home, that's 13,500 a month.
逾期交房：late delivery
90天之后我就可以要求取消购买、全额退款。
After 90 days I can cancel the purchase and get a full refund.
全额退款：a full refund
paraphrase: 阻挠验房=坐实开发商逾期
Blocking inspection proves the developer's delay.
把违约责任算给物业听
Spell out the penalty in front of them.
scenes.speak: I've recorded everything that just happened, so I'll take this to the housing authority. The contract's late-delivery penalty is 0.03% a day — on my 1.5 million home, that's 13,500 a month. After 90 days I can cancel the purchase and get a full refund.

practice: Handover comes first; fees come after.
Under Article 16, the developer pays the full fee.
I'll take this to the housing authority.
The late-delivery penalty is 0.03% per day.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：You block me from checking the house.
✓ 地道说法：You're stopping me from taking possession.
验房→take possession / inspect the unit。
✕ 直译腔：The property fee is paid by the developer in full amount.
✓ 地道说法：The developer pays the full property fee.
全额交纳→pay the full fee，更口语。
✓ 地道说法：The penalty is 0.03% per day.
每日万分之三→0.03% per day。
✕ 直译腔：I will go to the housing construction department to reflect.
✓ 地道说法：I'll take this to the housing authority.
反映→take this to / file a complaint。
shifts: 先切割责任：交接与费用分开
录音留证据+背出法规条文
把违约金与退房权算给物业听
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「屋业费」校正为「物业费」、「前属交接单」校正为「签署交接单」、「住间部门」校正为「住建部门」、「每天是3%」按合同语境校正为「每日万分之三」（150万房每月13500元可验算）、「白衬」校正为「白赚」、「四股车」不涉及本片；对话情境剧台词按语境理顺。
